children: HC Wainwright & Co. maintained their Buy rating on Anixa Biosciences's stock with a price target of $6.00.
The price target implies an upside of 122.2% from the Sep 21 close of $2.70.
Key takeaways from the analyst note

: Anixa Biosciences has reported encouraging preliminary efficacy and safety results from its ongoing Phase 1 clinical trial for the CAR-T therapy, liraltagene autoleucel (lira-cel), in ovarian cancer, with several patients surpassing one year of survival post-treatment. This positive data supports the potential of their therapies to significantly impact patient outcomes.

: The issuance of a new patent for Anixa's breast cancer vaccine technology in Australia, which complements existing patents in key international markets, enhances the company's competitive position and could facilitate future advancements in their clinical programs, reinforcing investor confidence.
